title: Samsung UK drops prices of Galaxy S26 phones by £250, Z Fold8 price by £100 for Black Friday
description: Samsung UK is running a Black Friday promo campaign that drops the prices of many of its premium Galaxy devices. There is a variety of offers – most are valid until December 1, but the best phone offers expire on November 17. Starting with the Samsung Galaxy Z Fold8, you can get £100 off with PayPal, plus a £30-£713 bonus when trading in an old device (these are the trade-in values of a Galaxy S20 128GB and a Galaxy Z Fold7 1TB, respectively). Samsung is making a “Black Friday Price Promise” – if you find the Z Fold8 for a lower price on select online retailers than on Samsung.com...

title: Oppo smartphone with 12,000mAh battery gets certification
description: Oppo could be gearing up to launch a smartphone with a massive 12,000mAh battery. An upcoming Oppo device, featuring the large-capacity cell, has reportedly received certification from China's Ministry of Industry and Information Technology (MIIT). According to the source, an Oppo smartphone bearing the model number PNC110 has received the MIIT approval in China. While the listing does not explicitly mention a 12,000mAh battery, its metadata reveals that the device packs an 11,460mAh cell, which could be marketed as a 12,000mAh battery. title: Schools that want Google Search for students will have to accept its AI too
description: Google has announced that its AI products will soon be switched off by default for K-12 student accounts. Namely, Gemini, Gemini Notebook, Gemini in Classroom, and Google Search will be "entirely off" until school administrators explicitly turn them on. In case you missed it, Google Search is on that list. The company says Search and AI are "deeply integrated", so a school that wants no AI at all for its students also has to give up Search for them. title: New info reveals the Samsung Galaxy S27 Pro won't be powered by the Snapdragon 8 Elite Extreme Gen 6
description: There's been a lot of talk lately about the chipset powering the Samsung Galaxy S27 Ultra, with a recent rumor claiming the smartphone would come with the Snapdragon 8 Elite Extreme Gen 6, at least in Europe. Now, the entire S27 lineup has been spotted in the NBD database, with the S27 Ultra listed with the Snapdragon 8 Elite Extreme Gen 6. The Galaxy S27 and Galaxy S27+ are listed with Samsung's Exynos 2700 SoC, while the Galaxy S27 Pro is listed with the Snapdragon 8 Elite Gen 6 chip instead of Snapdragon 8 Elite Extreme Gen 6. description: Xiaomi’s HyperOS 4 has a deeper integration with iOS – this includes easier sharing of photos, files, contacts and web pages with iPhone users. description: According to a renowned Chinese leaker on Weibo, the upcoming iPhone 18 will get performance and battery upgrades, in line with the current iPhone 18 Pro lineup. This year Apple shook things around by announcing only the Pro models from the iPhone 18 lineup, but reports suggest the company will announce the vanilla models in early 2027. At least the wait might be worth it, as the report suggests two major upgrades coming to next year's base iPhone. description: Motorola has launched multiple smartphones under the One lineup before, and we now know it's preparing to launch a new smartphone under the One series, as it has been Qi-certified by the Wireless Power Consortium (WPC). description: Apple unveiled the Apple Watch Series 12 and Watch Ultra 4 back in September, along with a set of microphone-based features it calls Audio Intelligence. title: vivo X500 FE and V80 FE pick up more certifications
description: vivo launched the X300 FE back in April, and its successor is already starting to show up in certification databases. Now, a vivo phone with the model number V2653 has been certified in Indonesia, and the listing also reveals its full marketing name: vivo X500 FE. title: WhatsApp starts suggesting your latest photos and videos right in your chats
description: WhatsApp already suggests stickers above the keyboard on Android based on the emojis you type, and now it's taking that suggestion system a step further. Media suggestions are rolling out to some users on both Android and iOS with the latest versions of the app. When you open a chat, WhatsApp can now offer to send whatever you most recently added to your gallery. There are two ways this can show up, and you'll only get one of them. In the first, a toast pops up above the chat bar as soon as you open a conversation. title: Samsung Galaxy A38's battery capacity leaks, and it's finally an upgrade
description: Samsung launched the Galaxy A37 back in March, and we've already heard that its successor will keep the same camera setup. Today, a new report from the same source claims the Galaxy A38 will get an upgrade over its predecessor after all, but in a different area: the battery capacity. The Galaxy A38 will allegedly have a battery with a rated capacity of 5,882 mAh, which should mean a typical capacity of 6,000 mAh. That's 20% more than the 5,000 mAh battery in the A37. title: Redmi Turbo 6 Max screen details leak, this could turn into the Poco X9 Pro Max
description: Redmi launched the Turbo 5 Max back in January, and its successor's design has already leaked. Today, a well-known Chinese tipster has shared new details about the Redmi Turbo 6 Max's display, which he calls a true flagship screen. The Turbo 6 Max will allegedly have a flat screen of about 7 inches, with a 2K resolution and a 185Hz refresh rate. It's said to use LIPO packaging, which shrinks the bottom bezel so it matches the others, leaving bezels of around 1mm on all four sides. description: During an earnings call on November 2, the company's CFO Kevan Parekh said that Apple is expecting Q4 this year to be the best quarter in the history of the company in terms of revenue. The fiscal Q4 2026 (ending in September) results point to a very optimistic near future for the company, despite the supply chain constraints, rising component prices and inventory shortages. The forecast comes amid Apple's record-breaking numbers reported in Q3 2026. title: Tipster brings bad news for the Galaxy Z Fold9 and Z Fold9 Ultra cameras
description: The Galaxy Z Fold9 models may bring back the under-display camera next year, but that might be the only camera upgrade they get. Tipster Lanzuk has scoured various sources and claims that the 2027 wide and book-style foldables will retain the same “rear” cameras as their predecessors. The Samsung Galaxy Z Fold9 Ultra will have a 200MP main camera, a 50MP ultra-wide and it will “maintain 3x optical zoom”. title: Android and iOS apps will be able to bypass the share sheet next year
description: Quick Share has come a long way over the past year. It started working with Apple's AirDrop on Pixels, then that support began spreading to other Android phones, and in August Google launched Tap to Share. Now, the company is going to let developers build Quick Share directly into their own apps - and not just on Android. At its Android Dev Summit, Google announced a Quick Share SDK that will be released in the first half of 2027, along with a Quick Share iOS SDK for iPhone apps. description: The Samsung Galaxy A58 is expected to arrive in March or April next year. While its exact launch date is unknown, China's 3C certification has revealed its charging speed. The Samsung Galaxy A58, which has received 3C certification, has model code SM-A5860 and supports 45W charging (10V/4.5A or 15V/3A), the same as its predecessor, the Galaxy A57. The 3C certificate also revealed that the Galaxy A58 will be sold without a charger in China. description: Back in June, a tipster claimed that Honor was developing a smartphone with a massive 14,000mAh battery. At the time, the battery was reportedly in the New Product Introduction (NPI) stage. A new leak now suggests that the battery has entered mass production. According to tipster Digital Chat Station, the battery will have a capacity of between 14,000mAh and 15,000mAh and has reportedly entered the trial production phase.
